title: Yerevan Kiosk, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Yerevan Kiosk within its distinct four-corner canopy: faceted blue upper room with three projecting window bays, pale lower marble panels/gold grilles, long open pointed portico and pale shafts/capitals, broad lead hip/colored soffit, shallow domed chamber and a descending garden stair/balcony. Independent Sacred Relics chamber, Sofa Kiosk, Mosque, pool, freestanding fountain and general terrace remain native context.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Independent Yerevan Kiosk Q6040439 / OSM way969327995 v14 / native35185341416827. The source page names Revan Köşkü/Yerevan Kiosk and Q6040439. Exact original four-corner canopy retained; internal+X southeast places the faceted room toward the garden end and internal+Z southwest faces the pool court.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Picture-led chamber/portico eaves6.3m above a shared floor, three projecting window bays, two window levels and a low lead dome on a short octagonal drum. Heights, hidden roof/dome profile, interior arrangement, column/window counts and garden stair dimensions are reconstruction controls, not a survey. Floor is .55m above the highest native boundary sample. The lower garden flight follows the pictured2.65m descent; the coarse native grid buries much of that descent.
